text: Good idea for presentation. Very good for cupcakes.

product_metadata.title: Katgely Individual Cupcake Containers (Pack of 50)- Single Compartment Clear Plastic Cupcake Boxes, Cupcake Holder - Stackable, Deep Dome, Disposable & BPA-Free
features: For Business & Celebrations: clear cupcake boxes that showcase & protect your beautifully decorated cupcakes with deep dome lids to hold the tallest frostings. Showcase in bakeries, dessert shops & ideal for any party celebration

Sturdy & Durable: the back hinge of the cupcake holder is extremely tough and can withstand multiple openings and closings without breaking whilst the front single bar lock ensures an airtight seal and easy opening

Convenient & Damage Free The stackable design of the clear cupcake container makes them ideal for displaying on a dessert table, easy to transport, and great for saving space. Its cavity shape allows the cupcake to be removed without damage to the frosting

High-Quality Materials: This single cupcake container is BPA Free and fully recyclable - crafted from PET plastic with recycling code 5. They can resist low temperatures, making them perfect for use in the freezer or refrigerator

Dimensions: the individual cupcake boxes have plenty of space for decorated cupcakes. Length: 3 7/8 Inches, Width: 4 5/16 Inches, Height: 3 5/8 Inches. The top and bottom compartment diameters measure 2 5/8 inches and 2 inches in diameter, respectively. The top diameter for a label is 1 8/10 inches
